items.finding: The text notes that the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands represents a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in both NIR and MIR, requiring tempered sample holders.
items.how_it_applies: This highlights why tracking process temperature might be critical when evaluating option O2, as temperature fluctuations could impact spectral bands related to water content.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited study reviews biopharmaceutical downstream processing rather than a petroleum stream, so the magnitude of temperature sensitivity may differ due to the different sample matrix.

citation.quote: Additionally, the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary [29].
